title: Why Do Bees Matter?
paragraphs: Bees are small insects. They fly from flower to flower. They take food from the flowers.
When a bee visits a flower, it carries a yellow powder. This powder helps the plant make fruit and seeds.
Many of our foods need bees. Apples, strawberries and almonds need them. Without bees, we have less food.
Today, bees have problems. They lose their homes and some chemicals hurt them. We can help. We can plant flowers.
